It is impossible to deny Egwene's achievements in the White Tower. Everything she did must not be dismissed. At the moment, the Tower must be holding the greatest number of women in more than a thousand years, all because of Egwene. Cadsuane always looked down on Aes Sedai in general because they did not have backbone. But recent events made her think differently, she even grew to respect Nynaeve. My greatest hope is that she will carry on with Egwene's idea of releasing damane. I think she will be a great Amyrlin.
